Terms and conditions

The Lion Liverpool

Our terms and conditions

Welcome to The Lion Restaurant, where your culinary journey through the rich tapestries of Sri Lankan and Japanese cuisines begins. By dining with us, you agree to the following terms and conditions designed to ensure a delightful and respectful experience for all our guests.

Reservations

  • We highly recommend making reservations in advance to secure your dining experience, especially for larger parties.
  • Please inform us of any cancellations or changes to your reservation at least 24 hours in advance.

Dietary Requirements

  • Our menu celebrates the diversity of Sri Lankan and Japanese cuisines, offering a variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Please inform our staff of any dietary restrictions or allergies when making your reservation or upon arrival.

Menu and Ingredients

  • Our culinary creations are an homage to the authentic flavors of Sri Lanka and Japan, featuring a symphony of spices, herbs, and the freshest ingredients. We pride ourselves on the bold tastes, vibrant colors, and captivating aromas of our dishes.
  • Menu items are subject to availability and seasonal changes. We strive to ensure the freshness and quality of our ingredients, which may occasionally result in modifications to our offerings.

Conduct

  • To maintain a pleasant atmosphere for all our guests, we kindly ask that you observe respectful behavior and dress appropriately while dining with us.
  • We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone who disrupts the dining experience for other guests.

Payment

  • We accept various forms of payment, including major credit cards and cash. Prices are subject to change without prior notice.
  • Gratuity is not included in the price. While tipping is at your discretion, it is greatly appreciated by our staff for exceptional service.

Liability

  • The Lion Restaurant is not responsible for any personal belongings left unattended or lost within our premises.
  • While we take utmost care in preparing our dishes, we cannot guarantee that menu items are completely free from allergens, as they are prepared in a kitchen that handles a variety of ingredients.

Feedback

  • Your dining experience is important to us. We welcome your feedback to continually improve and celebrate our culinary offerings.


By choosing to dine at The Lion Restaurant, you acknowledge and agree to these terms and conditions. We are thrilled to have you embark on this delightful culinary journey with us and look forward to serving you an unforgettable dining experience.

Thank you for choosing The Lion Restaurant.
